δούρων: δόρυ — wood, timber, spear; neut. gen. pl., ’of timber’
εὕρῃ: εὑρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. 2 subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest he find’
καταφθιμένοιο: καταφθίνω — perish, die, waste away; aor. mid. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’having perished, dead’
κερδοσύνῃ: κερδοσύνη — craftiness, cunning, native wit; fem. dat. sg. instrumental, rare word: ’by his craftiness’
κρουνοὺς: Κρουνοί — Crouni (’Springs’), a place on the coast; masc. acc. pl. (κρουνός ’spring’)
λάθῃσι: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic λάθῃ), after μή: ’lest it escape (you)’
μένουσι: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. 3 pl.: ’stay (moored)’
μιμνήσκεο: μιμνήσκω — mid. remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μιμνήσκου)
νῶι: ἐγώ (dual νῶι) — we two; acc. dual: ’the two of us’ (μετὰ νῶι ’after the two of us’)  ·  also used as nom. dual: νῶι … ἱκόμεθ’ ’we two have come’
οἰχομένη: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having gone off’
προπροκυλινδόμενος: προπροκυλίνδομαι — roll oneself forward, grovel along; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
προϊδών: προοράω — see before, see ahead; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
στῆθι: ἵστημι — set; aor. 2 intrans. stand; aor. imper. 2 sg. ’stand!’
φέρηται: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., after μή ’lest’: ’she may carry off (for herself)’
φρονέουσι: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσι)
ἀθρόα: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; neut. acc. pl.
ἀλάλκοιεν: ἀλέξω — ward off, keep off; redupl. aor. opt. 3 pl., epic ἀλάλκοιεν: ’might ward off’
ἀποστρέψασκε: ἀποστρέφω — turn back, turn away; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would turn back’
ἐπίκλοπος: ἐπίκλοπος — thievish, wily, deceitful; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg.
ἐϋδμήτους: εὔδμητος — well-built; masc. acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐδμήτους), agreeing with τοίχους
ἔλειπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’he left’
ὀνείρῳ: ὄνειρος — dream; masc. dat. sg., with εἴκελον: ’like a dream’ · also masc. dat. sg., locative: ’in a dream’ (ἔν περ ὀνείρῳ ’even in a dream’)
ὄρσας: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stirred up’
ὑποδείσας: ὑποδείδω — fear secretly, shrink in fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken fright’
ῥέζειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; pres. inf., used as an imperative · also pres. inf. of purpose: ’to sacrifice’
